Bayland Health.note: Bayland Health operates as an independent brand owner managing Micro Ingredients.

Bronson Laboratories.note: Twinlab Corporation sold its Bronson Laboratories division to Bronson Nutritionals, LLC in 2003.

Designs for Health, Inc..note: BDT & MSD Partners acquired a significant minority stake in the company in 2025.

FoodState, Inc..note: Pharmavite LLC acquired FoodState Inc, the maker of MegaFood, as a wholly owned subsidiary in 2014.

Holland & Barrett Retail Limited.note: L1 Retail acquired Holland & Barrett from The Carlyle Group for £1.77 billion in 2017.

Laperva.note: Laperva is an active global nutrition brand distributed primarily through Dr. Nutrition.

NOW Foods.note: The founding Richard family transitioned 30% of the company to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan in 2026, remaining independent.

Nature's Way Products, LLC.note: The company operates as a subsidiary of a European parent pharmaceutical company.

Nootropics Depot LLC.note: Nootropics Depot continues to operate as an independent supplement provider.

Obu Nutrition.note: Obu Nutrition operates as an independent GCC-focused wellness and supplement brand founded in 2020.

Sporter.note: Gulf Capital acquired a controlling stake in Sporter.com in 2016.
